# Astray 0.12.9
## What changed
- In the Chat composer, Command-Return now inserts a new line. Command-keypad Enter works the same way. - Return still sends the message, and Shift-Return remains available for a new line. - Includes the response copying and Chrome control improvements from 0.12.8.
## Install or update
- When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.12.9.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.12.8
## What changed
- Copy an entire Chat response with its Copy button, preserving the original Markdown. Select across paragraphs, lists, quotes and code, scroll to extend the selection, and copy with Command-C or the context menu. Code blocks retain their own Copy button. - Selecting response text pauses automatic scrolling. The composer accepts long pasted responses without the previous layout hang; Return sends and Shift-Return inserts a new line. - Chrome webpage guidance now prioritizes the connected Browser Bridge, including when Chrome is on another desktop Space. Scrolling prepares page focus before the first wheel event, improving control of inactive windows. - The new **Show unavailable windows** setting controls whether native input may restore or activate an unavailable window. Recovery returns a fresh observation before any requested input is attempted, and per-command restrictions respect the receiving Mac's setting. - Browser reconnection and control-session cleanup are more reliable. Chat preserves final explanations when a run finishes after tool failures and handles window recovery more consistently. - Includes Astray Browser Bridge 0.3.4. Chrome Web Store availability follows its separate review and update process.
## Install or update
- When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.12.8.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Update receiving Macs as well as the Mac sending commands. Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating. - For an unpacked Browser Bridge loaded from the app bundle, reload the extension in Chrome after replacing the app. Store-installed extensions update through Chrome. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
Native window recovery can bring the selected app forward or switch desktop Spaces when enabled. The setting controls recovery of unavailable windows; Foreground input mode still activates apps normally.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.12.5
## What changed
- Chat shows streamed activity, reasoning and tool results more consistently, and recovers history after reconnecting without reverting newer results. - Stop, cancellation and timeout handling more reliably finish cleanup, preserve partial results and distinguish commands that were never sent from commands whose outcome is unknown. - Model responses and tool calls handle rate limits, interrupted streams and invalid arguments more clearly, with better recovery guidance. - Native background input improves first-click delivery, target validation, foreground keyboard focus and menu cleanup after cancellation, timeout or window changes. - Browser control improves input targeting, labels, sensitive-value masking, iframe handling and coordinate clicks. Old requests are fenced off after reconnection or page changes. - Browser setup links to the Chrome Web Store and includes updated connection guidance. The bundled Browser Bridge is version 0.3.2; Chrome Web Store availability follows its separate review and update process.
## Install or update
- When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.12.5.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating. Update the Astray Browser Bridge extension when Chrome makes it available. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
Chat execution improvements require the corresponding Astray server update. Native popup menus can still raise their parent window above the foreground app; full background window isolation is not guaranteed.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.12.4
## What changed
- Choose the AI model and reasoning effort directly above the message box. Compact text menus keep the focus on your prompt and open each selection list without nested menus. - The model menu includes GPT-6 Astra and a wider selection of OpenRouter models. Reasoning options follow the selected model's supported levels, and Astray remembers each model's effort choice during the app session. - Each message uses the model and effort selected when it is sent, including subsequent tool steps in that run. - Server cleanup now handles disconnected sockets more reliably so interrupted runs can finish stopping and unlock the chat.
## Install or update
- When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.12.4.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
Model availability and Stop cleanup depend on the corresponding Astray server update. Model and effort choices are retained during the current app session.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.12.1
## What changed
- Control leases now last 15 minutes, with the remaining time and clearer recovery guidance shown when a Mac is busy. - MCP shutdown and cancellation release control more reliably, including interrupted requests, lost acquisition responses and blocked output. - Failed releases stay tracked for retry. Stale JavaScript device handles cannot release or renew a newer session's control. - Control status can be checked without acquiring a lease. Connection loss and interrupted relay requests clean up control more reliably.
## Install or update
- Update Astray on both the controlling and receiving Macs to get all control lease improvements. An older receiving Mac keeps its existing two-minute lease duration. - When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.12.1.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating, refresh the computer list and acquire a new control lease. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
## Scope and limits
- A persistent session retains control until it releases or resets the connection, or its lease expires. Finishing one command does not automatically release control. - A forced process kill, power loss or prolonged network interruption can still require connection cleanup or lease expiry before another session can acquire control. - Relay cleanup improvements require the corresponding Astray server update.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.12.0
## What changed
- A dedicated Computers panel keeps available Macs beside the conversation, with clearer connection status and Connect, Stop and Resume controls. - Shared-chat headers, sidebar controls, conversation spacing and typography have been refined. - Creating a New chat reuses your existing empty conversation in the workspace. Deleted conversations stay removed and are excluded from reuse. - Workspace invite links can be created and copied from the Computers panel. The app accepts official Astray website invite links, alongside the existing supported invite formats.
## Install or update
- When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.12.0.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating, refresh the computer list and acquire a new control lease. - Keep Astray open on both Macs and sign in with the same account, or explicitly share the receiving Mac with your workspace. Both Macs need Internet access and a reachable Astray server. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
## Scope and limits
- Chat reuse, deletion, connection checks and workspace invitations depend on the corresponding Astray server features. - Intel hardware execution and acceptance on two physical Macs on different networks are not covered by the automated release workflow.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.11.0
## What changed
- A simpler shared-chat layout brings workspace switching, new chat, search and account controls into a compact sidebar. Chat actions appear on selection, hover or keyboard focus, with accessible pin and unpin controls. - Chat headers and conversation spacing have been refined. Workspace sharing information stays available alongside contextual conversation controls. - **Nearby Computers** lists online Macs available through Astray's server from your account or shared workspace that you have not already opened in a tab. The **+** button offers the same available Macs. This uses the existing server connection, not local-network discovery. - Opening a Mac moves it into the window's Mac tabs. The open-Mac list belongs to the current window session. Clearer tab selection, separators and Stop/Resume controls make switching between chat and computer views easier.
## Install or update
- When control sessions and commands are idle, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.11.0.zip`, unzip it and replace `Astray.app` in Applications. - Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating, refresh the computer list and acquire a new control lease. - Keep Astray open on both Macs and sign in with the same account, or explicitly share the receiving Mac with your workspace. Both Macs need Internet access and a reachable Astray server. - Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
## Scope and limits
- This release refines the chat and computer interface on top of the central-server transport introduced in 0.10.0. - Intel hardware execution and acceptance of the transport on two physical Macs on different networks remain unverified by this release workflow.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.10.0
## What changed
- Computer tabs and external MCP sessions now connect through Astray's central server over authenticated WebSockets. Both Macs connect outward to the server, so they no longer need to share a local network. LAN discovery and pairing codes have been removed; there is no LAN fallback. - Workspace owners can copy an invitation link that opens on Astray's website. Recipients sign in with Google, confirm the account and explicitly join the workspace, then open it in the app. - Workspace membership and computer sharing remain separate. Joining a workspace does not share a Mac. Remote control checks membership, the owner's sharing choice and the receiving Mac's permission; disconnects, Stop and sharing revocation invalidate control without automatically replaying uncertain actions. - The app verifies server membership before opening a workspace from a web link and retains the requested workspace through sign-in.
## Install or update
- Update **both Macs** to 0.10.0 while control sessions and commands are idle, then sign in. Use the same account for your own Macs, or join a shared workspace and explicitly share the receiving Mac. - Choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**, or download `Astray-0.10.0.zip`, unzip it and replace the existing `Astray.app` in Applications. - Restart external MCP clients and persistent REPL sessions after updating. Discover the current computer list again and acquire a new control lease; old LAN identities and pairing codes no longer apply. - Both Macs need Internet access and a reachable Astray server. Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
## Verification and limits
- The matching server is deployed. Its HTTPS, production authentication, backup restoration and real Google web-invitation flow were verified; the production invitation check used an existing owner accepting their own link. - Native tests passed (376), along with the full server suite (400 passed, one skipped) and four additional OAuth exchange checks. A local test with two isolated native engines verified server-relayed commands, files, screenshots, receipts, disconnect cleanup, Stop/Resume and sharing revocation. - Two physical Macs on different networks have not yet completed acceptance of this new transport. Production invitation acceptance by a new member, Intel hardware execution and broader remote-control reliability remain unverified. - Web sign-in sessions expire after ten minutes and are cleared by a server restart; reopen the original invitation to continue.
Distribution uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The download archive and automatic-update feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.9.2
## What changed
- Changed Chat transcript layout to address a reproduced SwiftUI update loop that could leave the app unresponsive while inspecting messages and expanding tool results. - Deferred transcript scroll-state and floating control-panel updates until the current layout or state publication finishes. Scrolling up still pauses following, and Latest resumes it. - Prevented delayed commands from an ended control lease from cancelling work started under a newer lease. Old commands remain rejected and uncertain actions are not replayed.
## Verification and limits
- All 368 Swift tests passed on the integrated fixes. A disposable window using the real Chat view reproduced the previous hang; the changed layout completed 12 run-state transitions, 30 tool disclosures and 12 accessibility inspections. - Two physical Macs running 0.9.1 verified requester Chat Stop, native Mac-owner Stop, early cancellation after sharing revocation, and rejection of a separate new request to the unshared Mac. The later transcript hang was captured and retained separately from those results. - The layout fix still needs a paired retest after both Macs update. Long loaded transcripts can use more memory with this layout. General fullscreen control, remaining paired authentication/isolation/recovery checks and broader AI reliability remain open. - Google OAuth remains in Testing. Intel binaries are included; Intel hardware execution has not been verified.
## Install or update
- Choose **Astray → Check for Updates…** on both Macs and install 0.9.2 when control sessions and commands are idle. Reconnect afterward and reload any MCP session still using the previous app process. - For a new installation, download `Astray-0.9.2.zip`, unzip it and move `Astray.app` to Applications. Replace the existing app instead of merging its contents. - Requires macOS 14 or later. Includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
Public releases use Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The update archive and feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.9.1
## What changed
- Astray now rejects attempts to inspect or control its own process through Accessibility. This prevents a self-inspection path that can freeze the receiving app and stall control requests. The error asks you to select another app; observing Astray requires a separate process. - Updated Astray's logo, app icon, menu-bar symbol and bundled Chrome extension icons. - Added regression coverage for native control leases. Commands missing a required lease are rejected before execution; failed or uncertain commands are not automatically retried.
## Verification and limits
- Tests with two real users on two physical Macs verified default-Mac execution, explicit shared-Mac execution, private draft separation, shared run locking and workspace-owner Stop. Sharing revocation reported an interrupted, unknown outcome without replaying work. - The paired tests ran on 0.9.0 and exposed the self-inspection problem addressed here. Full paired acceptance, general fullscreen control and broader AI reliability remain open; malformed AI tool requests can still fail. - Google OAuth remains in Testing. Intel binaries are included, but execution on Intel hardware has not been verified.
## Install or update
- Choose **Astray → Check for Updates…** on both Macs and install 0.9.1 when control sessions and commands are idle. Reconnect afterward and reload any MCP session still using the previous app process. - For a new installation, download `Astray-0.9.1.zip`, unzip it and move `Astray.app` to Applications. Replace the existing app instead of merging its contents. - Requires macOS 14 or later. Includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
This release uses Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and a stapled ticket. The update archive and feed are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.

# Astray 0.9.0
## What changed
- Native Chat brings shared conversations, streamed AI replies and computer tool results into Astray. Search conversations, pin favorites and resume private drafts after restarting. - Sign in with Google to access your workspace and enable Mac execution. Login credentials are stored in macOS Keychain; signing out closes authenticated connections and control sessions. - Invite workspace members, see presence and coordinate composition with a typing lock. An active AI run keeps its Chat locked until execution and cleanup finish. - Requests start on the sending Mac by default. Explicitly share a Mac with your workspace to make it available for collaboration, and revoke sharing or stop execution from the native controls. - Reconnection restores conversation state without silently repeating uncertain computer actions. Tool cards distinguish queued commands, running terminal processes and confirmed outcomes.
## Current limits
- This is the first native Chat MVP release. Google OAuth remains in Testing; production branding and publishing are still pending. Google sign-in has been verified with the development account. - Native Chat acceptance with two users on two physical Macs is deferred. Local routing, native execution and controlled window observation have been tested on one physical Mac; Intel execution has not been tested on hardware. - AI screen interpretation and tool selection can be inaccurate. Successful controlled-window checks do not establish reliability across arbitrary applications. - Workspace member removal, ownership transfer and invitation revocation are not included in this MVP.
## Install or update
- In Astray 0.7.0 or later, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**. - When updating from 0.8.2 or earlier, close Settings before choosing **Install and Relaunch**. If an update is already waiting for Astray to quit, close its open panels and choose **Astray → Quit Astray**. - For a new installation, download `Astray-0.9.0.zip`, unzip it and move `Astray.app` to Applications. Replace the existing app instead of merging its contents. - Requires macOS 14 or later. Includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries. Google sign-in and an internet connection are required for native Chat.
This release is signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple and includes a stapled notarization ticket. Updates and update metadata are signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key. Existing pairing and app settings are retained; macOS controls permission approvals.

# Astray 0.8.0
Astray connects your Macs so Codex can work across them with your permission.
## What changed
- A first-run setup guide walks through each Mac's role, permissions, Codex integration, and pairing. - The home screen explains how to connect in Astray and start control in Codex. Screen previews are clearly marked as view-only. - Settings now groups Access, AI apps, and Updates into separate tabs. Codex setup includes an optional setup-help section. - File sending is explicit, with an optional connection check to try file transfer and remote interaction. - Control status shows the incoming controller and tracks control expiry. Fresh control stays active even if the other Mac's clock differs. - Sparkle continues to check for signed updates and waits for active remote work to finish before restarting Astray.
## Install or update
- In Astray 0.7.0 or later, choose **Astray → Check for Updates…**. - For a new installation or Astray 0.6.0, download `Astray-0.8.0.zip`, unzip it, and move `Astray.app` to Applications. - Requires macOS 14 or later. The app includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries.
This release is signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and includes a stapled notarization ticket. Update metadata and downloads are also signed with Sparkle's Ed25519 key.
Existing pairing and app settings are retained. macOS may ask you to review Screen Recording or Accessibility permission.

# Astray 0.7.0
Astray connects two Macs so you can keep working in the same AI conversation while using another Mac's apps, browser, and terminal.
- Automatic updates powered by Sparkle. Check for updates from the Astray menu, or manage automatic checks and downloads in Settings. - Updates wait for remote control and running commands to finish before restarting. - Native Chrome tab control with the Astray Browser Bridge extension. Set up the extension on the receiving Mac in Settings → Desktop → Chrome tabs. - Optional remote terminal commands. Enable Terminal commands on the receiving Mac. - A control activity panel shows who is connected and what they are working on. Set your display name in Settings.
Requires macOS 14 or later. One universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
## Install
1. Download `Astray-0.7.0.zip`, unzip it, and move `Astray.app` to Applications on both Macs. 2. Open Astray on both Macs, connect on the same local network, and enter the receiving Mac's pairing code. 3. On the requesting Mac, use Add to Codex to register the installed Applications copy, then reload the MCP server in Codex.
Users of 0.6.0 or earlier must install this version manually once. Subsequent releases can update through Astray.
Updating can require reconnecting the Macs and restarting an existing MCP session. macOS manages Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions on each Mac.
Background input remains experimental and depends on the target app. Keep both Macs up to date for feature compatibility.
